description: This file defines an Android activity (InstrumentationList) that displays a list of instrumentations available for a specified package, allowing user interaction such as selecting an instrumentation for testing or profiling. It also includes an inner adapter class (InstrumentationAdapter) for populating the list view.

classes.name: InstrumentationAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter to display a list of InstrumentationInfo objects, used by InstrumentationList to populate the list view with available instrumentations.

classes.name: InstrumentationList
classes.description: Main activity class that presents a list of instrumentation targets, allowing the user to select and run or profile them.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the list adapter, and restores profiling state if available.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates a menu with a profiling toggle option.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Updates menu item state based on current profiling mode.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current profiling mode state.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks by starting the selected instrumentation, optionally with profiling enabled.
